Firms of this kind typically rely on cloud providers and third party hosting for their own technology needs rather than operating dedicated data centers, and nothing in West Monroe's public materials or the building's own listings describes any data center function at this location.

Because this location is an office rather than a data center, there is no square footage, power capacity, or cooling specification to report for it in that sense, and none should be expected.
